promotions.behavior: Central compatibility gate validates mode, authorization, versions, canonical IDs, payload size, and owner-commit boundaries.
assumptions: Reforged compatibility infrastructure is not evidence of original MajorMUD import commands.
promotions.safeFallback: Reject the request without mutating owner state.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents unsafe or cross-mode import/export requests.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: No direct mutation; Character save owner validates and commits.
promotions.worldStateImpact: No direct mutation; owning world subsystem validates and commits.

promotions.behavior: Classic imports preserve canonical identifiers and reject Reforged extension packages.
assumptions: Classic compatibility requires stable source identifiers.
promotions.safeFallback: Reject non-preserving or extension-bearing Classic requests.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents Custom/AI schema leakage into Classic mode.

promotions.behavior: WCC/WBB decoding and migrations remain delegated to dedicated decoders and owning subsystem validators.
assumptions: A compatibility coordinator must not invent binary semantics.
promotions.safeFallback: Return a typed dependency warning and require owner commit.
promotions.runtimeImpact: Preserves decoder and runtime ownership boundaries.
